column5: Provider=get_db; Injector=FastAPI Depends; Dependency=SQLAlchemy Session; Consumers=route functions in attendance.py, auth.py, classes.py, members.py, notifications.py, payments.py, plans.py and trainers.py
column7: FastAPI injects the session returned by get_db into route parameters declared with Depends(get_db). get_db creates the session, yields it to the route and closes it in a finally block.

column5: Provider functions=get_current_user, get_current_admin, get_current_trainer, get_current_member; Injector=FastAPI Depends; Dependencies=oauth2_scheme and User; Consumers=protected route functions across attendance, classes, members, notifications, payments, plans and trainers routers
column7: Protected routes request current_user through Depends. Role-specific providers depend on get_current_user, which itself depends on the OAuth2 token scheme and database session. This separates authentication and authorization from route logic.
